name: ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_
description: This table stores Party Tax Profile Information

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for party type

columns.name: SUPPLIER_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this party tax profile is for a third party supplier

columns.name: CUSTOMER_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this party tax profile is for a third party customer

columns.name: SITE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this party tax profile is for a third party site

columns.name: PROCESS_FOR_APPLICABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether taxes should be automatically calculated  for this party tax profile

columns.name: ROUNDING_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Rounding level code to be used for rounding of taxes calculated for this party tax profile

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Rounding rule code to be used for rounding of taxes calculated for this party tax profile

columns.name: WITHHOLDING_START_DATE
columns.description: Withholding start date for this party tax profile

columns.name: INCLUSIVE_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether transaction line amounts include tax amount  for this party tax profile. This column is applicable for only suppliers.

columns.name: ALLOW_AWT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether tax withholding is allowed  for this party tax profile

columns.name: USE_LE_AS_SUBSCRIBER_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether Legal Entity should be used for determining taxes for transactions of  this party tax profile. This column is applicable only for operating units.

columns.name: LEGAL_ESTABLISHMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this party tax profile is for a first party legal establishment

columns.name: FIRST_PARTY_LE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this party tax profile is for a first party legal entity

columns.name: REPORTING_AUTHORITY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this party tax profile is for a reporting tax authority

columns.name: COLLECTING_AUTHORITY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this party tax profile is for a collecting tax authority

columns.name: PROVIDER_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that identifies whether the third party provider offers tax content or tax services or both

columns.name: CREATE_AWT_DISTS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the event when tax is automatically withheld for this party tax profile (Never, Approval, Payment)

columns.name: CREATE_AWT_INVOICES_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the event when withholding tax invoices are automatically created for this party tax profile (Never, Approval, Payment)

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Default tax classification code for this party tax profile

columns.name: SELF_ASSESS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether taxes are self-assessed  for this party tax profile

columns.name: ALLOW_OFFSET_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether offset taxes are allowed for this party tax profile

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM_USE_LE
columns.description: Effective start date from which  Legal Entity is used to determine taxes for transactions of this party tax profile. This column is applicable only for operating units.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier

columns.name: REP_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Tax registration number  for this party tax profile. This column is applicable only for suppliers, customers and first party legal establishments.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate registration type

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code used to validate the tax registration number  for this party tax profile

columns.name: MERGED_TO_PTP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the party tax profile into which this party tax profile is merged

columns.name: MERGED_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the status of party merge for this party tax profile

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: WHT_DATE_BASIS
columns.description: Attribute to indicate whether the withholding date basis to be adopted for the party is invoice date or accounting date.

columns.name: ALLOW_ZERO_AMT_WHT_INV_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether zero amount withholding invoices can be created.

columns.name: WHT_ROUNDING_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Rounding level code to be used for rounding of withholding taxes calculated for this party tax profile.

columns.name: WHT_ROUNDING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Rounding rule code to be used for rounding of withholding taxes calculated for this party tax profile.

columns.name: WHT_USE_LE_AS_SUBSCRIBER_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether legal entity should be used for determining withholding taxes for transactions of this party tax profile. This column is applicable only for business units.

columns.name: WHT_EFFECTIVE_FROM_USE_LE
columns.description: Start date that the business unit uses the withholding tax configuration of the associated legal entity.

columns.name: TRANSPORT_PRVDR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the party is a transportation provider such as freight carrier.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: USE_SYSTEM_DEFAULTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that application default values of tax status, rate, recovery rate, taxable basis formula, or tax calculation formula are used in tax calculation when an incomplete or inconsistent configuration is found.

columns.name: TAX_GROSS_NET_FLAG
columns.description: Transaction tax applicability on the gross or net amount indicator.

columns.name: WHT_GROSS_NET_FLAG
columns.description: Withholding tax applicability on the gross or net amount indicator.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRN_DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description:
This column indicates whether the customer tax 
 registration number should be defaulted on Receivables transactions for this leg
 al entity. Y indicates yes, and N indicates no.

columns.name: TAX_REG_LAST_VALIDATION_DATE
columns.description: The date when the current registration record was last validated by the tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_REG_VALIDATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The current validation status of the tax registration, as received from the tax authority.
